premises.text: Web3 games have become an important part of the web3 ecosystem and can provide alternative funding sources for developers
premises.evidence_span: web3 games have become a very important part of the web3 ecosystem over the last couple of years starting with the rise of axie infinity which has a game economy that's whose value is measured in like billions of dollars

premises.text: Integrating web3 into games allows for more engaging and immersive experiences with player communities
premises.evidence_span: it's a way to build much more engaging and immersive games with the collaboration of their player communities than ever existed before

premises.text: Game economies in web3 require management similar to real economies to avoid crashing
premises.evidence_span: as soon as you have a game that has like some amount of traction on web3 your biggest problem is how do i make sure my economy doesn't crash

premises.text: Healthy game economies require participants to produce and for taxes to create value
premises.evidence_span: the first principle is that the people who are participating in the economy should be able to produce in that economy and the second principle is that there should be you know taxes create value

premises.text: Moonstream provides features to help games maintain healthy economies
premises.evidence_span: we offer a variety of features on our platform that help games maintain healthy economies

premises.text: Moonstream charges for its services based on monthly fees and per interaction fees
premises.evidence_span: we charge a thousand dollars per month to anyone who wants to know what's going on in an on-chain economy and then for game projects we charge as an infrastructure provider we charge them 10 cents per interactions that their users make against our platform

value.text: Games can maintain healthy economies through effective management and community engagement

notes: Traction metrics and team introduction excluded as they do not represent premises.
